name: cuit-server-loadtest
description: k6 压测套件，覆盖冒烟、负载、压力、浸泡和登录场景

scripts.1c1g: mkdir -p reports && k6 run --env MODE=1c1g --summary-export=reports/api-1c1g.json api.js
scripts.load: mkdir -p reports && k6 run --env MODE=load --summary-export=reports/api-load.json api.js
scripts.stress: mkdir -p reports && k6 run --env MODE=stress --summary-export=reports/api-stress.json api.js
scripts.soak: mkdir -p reports && k6 run --env MODE=soak --summary-export=reports/api-soak.json api.js
scripts.soak-1c1g: mkdir -p reports && k6 run --env MODE=soak-1c1g --summary-export=reports/api-soak-1c1g.json api.js
scripts.inspect: k6 inspect --env ACCOUNTS_FILE=data/accounts.example.json api.js && k6 inspect --env ACCOUNTS_FILE=data/accounts.example.json login.js
